name: gecodis-crm
description: CRM B2B nouvelle génération pour le secteur logistique, transport et immobilier logistique

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=apps/api & npm run dev --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=apps/api && npm run lint --workspace=apps/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/api
scripts.start:api: npx prisma migrate deploy --schema apps/api/prisma/schema.prisma && (npm run prisma:seed --workspace=apps/api || true) && node apps/api/dist/main.js
scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace=packages/shared && npm run build --workspace=apps/web
